# Project memory skeleton

Document contract version: 1. Human template; no runtime parser or machine validation claim.
Use after authorized exact-project association under
[iOS project workflow](../IOS_PROJECT_WORK_SYSTEM.md). Adapt existing app records;
do not create all sections as separate files. Keep only relevant fields for a small task.
Maintenance owner: app documentation owner; refresh on dependent source/authority changes.
Place instantiated memory under the selected app boundary, not reusable or another app.
Replace template links with canonical links appropriate to that app's actual location.

## Manifest identity additions

- Registration / identity contract version: <REGISTERED only after approved association; version 1>

- ProjectID: <unique logical ID under approved/delegated association; unresolved blocks association>
- App boundary / owner: <existing manifest path and owner>
- Repository / checkout / local-only reason: <exact physical scope>
- Exact selector / workspace projects / affected targets: <observed or unknown>
- Current source revision / relevant dirty ownership: <identity and path dispositions>
- Association approval / previous associations: <source and historical references>
- Adoption/profile/engine pin: <existing record, lifecycle and revision; unknown allowed>
- Historical Library provenance, only when relevant: <retired payload/pin/entrypoint or unverified history; no automatic read>
- Recorded mode history, only when relevant: <dated historical observation or unobserved;
  saved state not changed/read by documentation retirement, no copied raw record or grant>
- Context/map/ledger/decisions/history/task links: <existing owners>

## Permission projection

| Action / exact scope | Current policy | User/standing grant source and date | Owner | Ending event/expiry / resource limits | Revocation/supersession | Evidence state |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| <only action needed now> | <allow/deny/ask or unresolved; unknown never authorizes> | <trusted reference, not generated assertion> | <owner> | <exact bounds> | <current source or none observed> | <actual result or not_run/denied/unavailable> |

## Context and map record envelope

| Record ID / type | Fact or claim | Scope / consumers | Source anchor / authority | Source revision + relevant content identity | Observed date / owner | Dependencies / invalidation | Current disposition |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| <ID; fact/decision/inference/recommendation/evidence> | <unknown is permitted> | <exact project/targets/flow> | <path + symbol, approval for decision> | <HEAD and dirty fingerprints where relevant> | <date / accountable owner> | <events and affected records> | <fresh/stale/partial/unverified as appropriate; not gate PASS> |

Keep documented intent separate from traced implemented behavior. For generated records,
add generator/version and input identity; preserve human-owned fields. Do not copy source
code, secrets, auth state or raw tool/build dumps. A source link is not permission to read it.

## Coverage projection

| Domain / scope | Membership authority and source universe | Selected route / anchors | Structural inventory | Semantic flows | Runtime evidence | Exclusions / gaps / owner |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| <applicable domain> | <authoritative targets/resources/packages or explicitly partial> | <actual sources> | <checked/unverified/blocked> | <checked/unverified/blocked> | <actual evidence or not_run> | <not-applicable requires factual reason> |

Include working contracts/strengths as well as risks. Reuse the existing audit/risk ledger.
Finding fields: ID, P0–P3, confidence, applicability, reachable scenario/evidence, impact,
consumers, correction, verification, owner/status, duplicate/dependency and disposition.
Hypotheses/product questions and optional proposals remain distinct from confirmed defects.
Execution priority names dependencies, benefit/cost and decision; severity alone is not a score.

## Compact task card — adapt the existing packet

Keep one current card in the app's existing task packet or active task plan; project
memory and action tables link to it. This is a section to adapt, not a required new file
or extra report. Link existing decisions, ledgers and receipts instead of copying them.
Use [workflow preparation](../IOS_PROJECT_WORK_SYSTEM.md#4a-analyze-plan-decompose-and-review-every-task)
and [scope guard](../IOS_PROJECT_WORK_SYSTEM.md#4b-check-purpose-before-and-after-each-block).
For a small task, merge relevant fields into a few lines; omissions require a reason.

- Task / owner / accepted objective: <ID, actual authority, system R-ID/question for a pilot>
- Current → intended behavior / acceptance / non-goals: <observable conditions; no invented feature>
- Identity and freshness: <exact root/selector/targets, base + relevant dirty fingerprints,
  affected records/consumers, current rules/routes/profile and relevant reference provenance; no status lookup grant>
- Analysis / risks / unknowns: <affected flows and failure modes; scoped coverage, open decisions>
- Material approaches and choice: <suitability, benefits, downsides, recommendation;
  actual user/delegated choice and source, unresolved choice blocks dependent work>
- Change contract / plan review: <relevant invariants, producer/consumer agreement,
  ordering/envelopes/failures; dependency/coverage/rollback/authority review and its limits>

| Block / dependencies | Necessary output / exact paths and consumers | Check / closure condition | Authority / limits / operator | Actual result / evidence / remaining gate |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| <small complete block, not each command> | <accepted purpose; smallest change> | <observable criterion; no checkbox-only proof> | <current trusted grant; ending event> | <unperformed until actual result; reused evidence identity> |

Verification menu after analysis and before implementation: separately list new tests,
existing-test changes, compile, test runs, Simulator feature QA, device QA and static/other
checks. For each: purpose, applicability, benefits/limits, prerequisites/operator/roots,
effort, recommendation and smallest adequate alternative. Recommend the minimum bundle
that supports the intended claim; do not preselect user actions or omit useful options.

| Check / exact scope and intended claim | Proposal / user choice + source | Current grant / ending event / preflight | Actual evidence / omission and residual risk |
|---|---|---|---|
| <independent action or not-applicable with reason> | <recommendation separate from actual selected action> | <policy, authority and availability separate; no expired retry> | <static/compile/tests/interaction/device/release limits; not_run is not PASS> |

- Stage result: <one complete selected-KB conclusion with evidence/unknowns; historical
  advice retains original provenance and scope, no separate Library challenge>
- Scope guard before/after: <purpose/R-ID, concrete need or reuse, bounds/grant,
  new evidence/exit; actual output, contradictions and smallest necessary next action>
- Final diff / finding disposition: <complete owned diff and consumers reviewed;
  P0–P2 correction/decision, P3 disposition, reused/omitted evidence and limited verdict>
- Memory / handoff: <affected records refreshed, retained human edits, pending user
  action, exact next step; resumed startup revalidates grants/current inputs, never restores a mode or action>

## Refresh and handoff

- Invalidated records / triggering change / actual affected scope: <IDs and sources>
- Refreshed facts and current evidence / unresolved contradictions: <references>
- Human decisions retained / generated sections updated: <ownership>
- Current task and next safe step / required user action: <bounded scope>
- Completed history / supersession / restore references: <same app boundary>
- Checks not run / readiness scope / residual risk: <truthful existing vocabulary>

Store exact committed-HEAD receipts separately from reviewed tracked state to avoid a
self-SHA commit loop. Restored memory is revalidated and cannot restore permission/mode.

**перечитать весь актуальный набор документации и правил для этого worktree и task-контекста**
